title: Automatic shared Google Web Risk protection across enabled public sites and all nine feature contexts

scope.architecture: One shared threat service reused by the existing protection coordinator and feature tools; generic public-URL policy rather than a Wikipedia/VideoLAN/Resell-only implementation.
scope.preserve: Current all-nine-feature work, source identities, typed contracts, user control, private-data exclusions, independent evidence, parked Amazon seller-feedback and UI/UX-last order.
scope.not_added: No file-content malware scan, universal site-safety guarantee, global browser request firewall, arbitrary crawler or new browser-agent framework.

record_scope: Public planning excerpt. Requirements describe intended scope; build verification is recorded separately.
